title: First principles rationale of strain-induced modifications in hybrid double halide perovskite: optoelectronics and photovoltaic perspectives
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,25094-25102
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02285E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tanmoy Kalita, Manjet Rajak, Dhruba Jyoti Kalita
Strain engineering effectively tunes the optoelectronic properties of (DMA)2SnCl6. Applying 6% tensile strain optimizes the band gap and absorption, achieving a peak power conversion efficiency of 29.28% while ensuring structural stability.
